description: Defines the Vtiger_Role class for managing user roles in vtiger CRM, including role hierarchy, retrieval, movement, and deletion operations.

classes.name: Vtiger_Role
classes.description: Represents a user role with hierarchy management in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getInstanceByResult
methods.description: Creates a Vtiger_Role instance from a database query result row.

methods.name: getInstanceById
methods.description: Retrieves a role instance by role ID from the database.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the role to a new parent role, updating hierarchy and depth.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the role and cleans up related data, updating subordinate roles accordingly.
